But we also emphasize it because it is the core \u003Cstrong>value\u003C\u002Fstrong> that drives how we work every single day — together, in partnership, and always for patients.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>We also embrace the idea of \u003Cstrong>Kabegoe\u003C\u002Fstrong>, which means breaking down barriers. As individuals\u2028and as a team, we believe that no wall is too high, no challenge too great. Ours is a “can do” mindset and culture.\u003C\u002Fp>",[],[],{"__typename":318,"id":382,"removeSpace":169},"2494",{"__typename":384,"id":385,"panelOptions":386,"subTitle":21,"title":21,"description":21,"centerDesktop":22,"link":21,"videoItem":387,"sliderType":21},"ComponentPanelsVideoSlider","1258",{"panelId":21,"panelDisable":21,"backgroundColor":376},[388,399,408],{"id":389,"video":21,"videoDuration":390,"cover":391,"transcript":396,"caption":397,"youtubeID":398},"3941","00:55",{"url":392,"width":393,"height":394,"alternativeText":395},"\u002Fuploads\u002FThe_Mindset_and_Culture_048910d8d4.png",1200,676,"Woman seated and speaking","\u003Cp>When you walk into one of our offices, no matter where that is, there’s a feeling of warmth that you get. It’s just this environment where you actually feel like you can be yourself and that people around you enjoy what they’re doing. And I think it’s just that overwhelming sense of belonging.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>I would say this culture here, this company is so unique. It, number one, is a very welcoming and inclusive environment, and I would say highly collaborative as well. We know we’re always collaborating. We’re always ready to help each other out, and we’re always ready to uplift each other.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>Since joining here, it’s definitely met my expectations as far as people not just willing to work together, but they’d like to work together. They want to help you succeed, which I think is terrific.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>Respect is a foundation in the Japanese culture. I think when you have respect, that you’re feeling appreciated and I think that makes you work harder and want to be part of the team.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>I’ve worked at a few other pharmaceutical companies and it’s palpable, the culture and you can feel it.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>There’s never any hesitation, just the willingness to really support one another and really be, I feel like, really be a part of a team here.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>I don’t feel embarrassed to ask and to get the whole team on board and help me out or, or we help somebody out. So it’s very inclusive, and the teamwork is amazing.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>You know, when I reach out to colleagues for anything, whether, you know, I want to ask for a little bit of, you know, people’s time, they’re so willing to, you know, volunteer of themselves at any point.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>No one here is shy to say hello. There’s always ways to connect here, especially at the new office. We have these great cafes, great areas just to sit down and meet.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>Regarding the culture of the company, over time we’ve obviously grown. And so, as you get more people, the culture changes. But what has been consistent, especially with our side in La Jolla, is the teamwork and collaborative spirit and the recognition that we’re stronger when we work together.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>And I think the beauty of the Japanese culture brings that harmony together while at the same time allowing us to innovate on behalf of patients.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>There’s an environment here where you feel people genuinely care about the work they’re doing and for whom they’re serving. Our patients and our communities.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>You know, this is one of our core values, wanting to make our patients smile around the innovations that we create. And that’s what makes this special.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>I think we Kyo Kiran actually lives its values, which is sometimes rare for some, some companies. Everyone here, I feel like believes in, in the, in the values of Kyo Kiran and lives in and does science that way.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>So I’m definitely proud to work for Kyo Kiran North America, because our culture is exactly as described.\u003C\u002Fp>","We let our culture be our guide","Aq9ynA9EMmY",{"id":400,"video":21,"videoDuration":401,"cover":402,"transcript":405,"caption":406,"youtubeID":407},"3942","02:57",{"url":403,"width":393,"height":394,"alternativeText":404},"\u002Fuploads\u002FOur_Culture_46bdf7b8a0.png","Three seated people talking","\u003Cp>We think our Cultural Ambassador program really makes Kyowa Kirin a special place to work.  We started the program to ensure that even as we're growing as a company, that we remain committed to a culture where employees collaborate, respect each other, and like working together.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>This is a group that brings new ideas to the table and knows that we'll do our best to bring those ideas into reality.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>And what's really cool, is the work that they do inspires other employees to do the same.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>So, the impact that they've had over the years that I've been here is in policy trainings, culture, feedback into the senior leadership team on key issues.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>We introduced new benefits and offerings based on feedback from our culture ambassadors.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>So, this group is a huge touch point and pulse on the organization.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>The culture ambassador program is absolutely novel and distinctive.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>We have executive sponsors, myself and a Co leader. We have champions from the HR team as well as public affairs.  We have close to 30 members.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>So, I think that the fact in which not only do we have the membership, but we also have the structure and the governance around it to make sure that we are successful.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>Being a cultural ambassador, we get to meet with some folks from other teams that we may not meet in our day-to-day, including some executive sponsors.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>So that gives us an opportunity to learn more about them, learn from them and grow from what they have shared and actually help develop the company itself.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>Being a cultural ambassador is a chance to have an opportunity to change the company.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>What I'm hoping to accomplish is, people who especially who are new and people who aren't as social, just helping them feel more welcome and helping them feel included because I've, I've been there as well.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>I've been the new person and what I would like to be for others.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>I care about this company and I care about the people that work for our company.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>And what, you know, I would like to bring to it is it's taking people's suggestions and feelings and what they like to see within the corporate world and their culture, diversity, and coming together.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>I want to be able to create that community and bring us closer and tighter and further our our work that we do here.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>It's really my passion.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>We want to have the most engaged base of employees possible, employees who like working together, who understand the importance of working with one another and then who can contribute their ideas to advance the mission.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>\u003Cbr>And our cultural ambassadors have just been a fantastic asset and a resource to our organization as we've gone through our growth journey. \u003C\u002Fp>","The unique culture of Kyowa seated and speaking","\u003Cp>I think it's important for Kyowa Kirin to have ERGs because diversity drives our core values, especially innovation and teamwork.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>We have 3 Employee Resource Groups. We have EmBrace, we have WIN, which is Women's Initiative Network, and then we have PRIDE.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>We organize, we strategize over how to educate the people around us so that they become more understanding, standing and familiar with the issues that LGBTQ plus members of that community face on a daily basis.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>I started my journey in diversity, equity and inclusion and employee resource groups when I was with my former company. At that time, I was not comfortable in my own skin, and so I wanted to take on a bold step and get involved in the Pride group.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>It allowed me to, you know, walk into a room and speak without reservation, to have more confidence in myself and really speak my mind to advance my opinions. And so, you know, it it, it helped a lot.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>We're trying to show some of the employees who may be considered vulnerable or may not be used to being their authentic self that you can and that this is a company where you can do that.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>I many times face gender based differences, challenges and barriers, but I'm happy to tell you that I could find ways to navigate those.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>And in Women Initiative Network, we exactly do the same.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>We are a group of employees who are very motivated to support this breaking such challenges or barriers which comes on our way based on gender.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>As an Employee Resource Group lead, I wish that all employees here in Kyowa Kirin feel confident and a sense of belongingness at workplace.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>Once you better understand the shoes that your colleague walks in, it helps in open one's awareness.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>It helps bring more understanding and embracing of inclusivity, which is what we're trying to achieve as a part of the Embrace ERG.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>It's important that we all work together and support one another, celebrate the differences, help and strive toward inclusivity and belonging within Kyowa Kirin, I will say from personal experience, since being here, I've never felt anything less than accepted for who I am.\u003C\u002Fp>\u003Cp>All those experiences really helped shape me into the person that I am today.\u003C\u002Fp>","How ERG adds value to our company","Y6UiW8jOYpw",{"__typename":321,"id":418,"panelOptions":21,"title":419,"content":420,"centerDesktop":22,"imageGrid":324,"images":421,"removeComponentSpace":21},"800","We are relentlessly focused on improving patients’ lives","\u003Cp>We are inspired by the patients we serve.
